text:
sam_sales: @elaine_pm quick heads-up — Mallory Health is asking for dedicated capacity for their new clinical summarization feature. They expect steady 50 req/s embeddings + 20 RPS small generative chat during day, but with peak bursts up to 1.8k RPS for 10–15m during morning syncs. Can we size this and recommend a playbook?

elaine_pm: thanks. Do we have model profile + target latency and SLOs?

mike_se: Mallory sent some details: embeddings = open-embed-1 (1536-dim), avg embed QPS 50. Chat uses redwood-chat-medium; avg response ~200 tokens (prompt ~100 tokens -> ~300 tokens total).

anya_eng: ok.. for sizing we need to separate embeddings (vector CPU/GPU ops) vs generation (GPU token throughput). Also need tokenization assumptions and whether they'll use KV cache for multi-turn.

sam_sales: they will use short multi-turn (avg 3 turns), and are willing to accept cache enablement. Target p95 for steady <400ms, burst can tolerate up to 1s p95.

devon_infra: two asks we should clarify: (1) steady baseline sizing for reserved pool, (2) burst policy (credits, window) and overflow behavior. Also what fallback model to route to during peak.

mike_se: quick math (confirming numbers): steady gen = 20 RPS * 300 tokens = 6k tokens/s. Peak = 1800 RPS * 300 tokens = 540k tokens/s. Embeddings steady = 50 QPS (vector ops) — low token cost but CPU/GPU memory considerations for batching.

anya_eng: performance note: from our benchmarks redwood-chat-medium quantized runs at ~600 tokens/s/GPU under mixed workload assumptions (with batching and KV). Non-quantized maybe ~200–300 tps/GPU. So pick conservative 600 tps/GPU for quantized variant.

lisa_fin: keep in mind pricing: customer wants 6-month reserved commitment + ability to burst. We'll need a reserved base + burst premium model.

mike_se: straight calc: steady 6k tps -> ~10 GPUs (6k/600 = 10). Peak 540k tps -> 900 GPUs (unrealistic). So we must avoid linear allocation for peak. Recommend multi-pronged approach: autoscale pool, burst credits + short window, fallback to smaller quantized model, and overflow to hosted multi-tenant (with higher per-token charge). Also strong caching (prefix + KV) to shave peak token counts.

elaine_pm: clear product deliverables requested by Sales/CS: (A) burst playbook (burst window, credit model, fallback routing), (B) autoscale policy template for reserved customers, (C) recommended model variants and quantization ladder for degrade, (D) pricing + contract language for reserved+burst. Deadline: EOW next Friday so Sales can present to Mallory.

anya_eng: I'll draft the playbook and include sizing examples, config snippets, and a decision tree for fallbacks. Sample pool config to include in playbook:

```
pool:
  base_gpus: 12
  burst_policy:
    window_mins: 15
    token_credit_rate_per_min: 200000
    max_burst_multiplier: 8
    fallback_model: redwood-chat-small-q4_8
  autoscale:
    target_util: 0.7
    cooldown_sec: 120
    max_gpus: 100
```

mike_se: add pre-warm hooks and cache TTL recommendations. Also suggest regional spillover to hosted API endpoints if dedicated pool is saturated (with higher cost).

devon_infra: infra checklist: pre-warm warmup jobs, queue backpressure thresholds, autoscaler ops runbook, and monitoring alerts (gpu_util >85% for >2m, queue_latency >300ms). We'll need to test scale-up times to ensure autoscale meets 15min burst window.

lisa_fin: I'll prepare pricing bands: base reserved X GPUs/month + burst credits bundle (per 15min window) + overage per-token rate for hosted overflow. I'll sketch contract clauses about burst fairness and throttling.

mike_se: engineering spike: benchmark 3 variants (redwood-chat-medium, redwood-chat-medium-q4_8, redwood-chat-small-q4_8) under mixed RL and prefix-cache scenarios. Need numbers for tokens/s per GPU and latency at 70/85/95% util.

elaine_pm: I'll create the backlog ticket with acceptance criteria: playbook PDF + triage matrix + sample config + pricing draft + benchmark results + sample contract language. Owners: @anya_eng (playbook + configs), @mike_se (benchmarks + prewarm), @lisa_fin (pricing), @devon_infra (autoscale infra).

deploybot: Ticket created: PROD-1542 — 'Mallory Health dedicated burst playbook' assigned to elaine_pm. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PROD-1542 :white_check_mark:

sam_sales: thanks all, this looks good. I'll sync with Mallory and share the ticket. :thumbsup:
